PREP_COMMAND: cd web/symoneural-web && go mod download # needs Go >= 1.25.1
INSTALL_COMMAND: sudo install -m0644 ops/symoneural-web.service /etc/systemd/system/ && sudo systemctl daemon-reload
REPRODUCIBLE_BYTES: NO -- binary embeds its own git commit and build id
NETWORK_REQUIRED: YES -- modules AND possibly the toolchain itself; see NOTES
NOTES: THE PRODUCTION WEB SERVER for symoneural.com, and it has no fallback. An earlier draft recorded its source as site/ and its build system as python generators -- conflating the served ASSETS with the SERVER. The unit's measured ExecStart is web/symoneural-web/build/symoneural-web run --environ --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile. Served assets are the separate symoneural-site component. CLASSIFICATION: main.go is 146 lines of FIRST-PARTY Go that IMPORTS Caddy as an Apache-2.0 LIBRARY -- it does not fork, patch or vendor it, and it explicitly refuses the copy-caddy-under-our-name shortcut as a false authorship claim. So the application source is ours and Caddy is a package dependency: THIRD_PARTY_SOURCE_CARRIED_IN_BACKUP=NO, REBUILDABLE_FROM_LOCKED_MODULES=YES via go.sum (573 entries). BUILD AUTHORITY is ops/build-symoneural-web.sh, NOT a plain `go build`: it stamps -ldflags -X main.version/gitCommit/buildID/licenseSHA and emits THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md over 547 modules plus go-modules.tsv and build-manifest.json. A plain go build produces a binary whose --version honestly reports `unknown`, which is by design -- verified by building it both ways. TOOLCHAIN: go.mod requires go 1.25.1; this host's Debian Go is 1.24.4 and GOTOOLCHAIN=auto silently fetches golang.org/toolchain@v0.0.1-go1.25.1 as a module. With GOTOOLCHAIN=local the build FAILS rc=1. A restored machine therefore needs Go >= 1.25.1 or network access to fetch it; the module and toolchain caches are NOT carried in the archive.
